text: Code reviews are a vital practice in software development. When one developer writes code, another team member carefully checks it before it is merged into the main project. This process helps catch bugs early, saving significant time and money that would otherwise be spent fixing problems later. Beyond finding errors, code reviews offer a powerful chance for knowledge sharing. Junior developers learn from senior colleagues, and even experienced coders discover new shortcuts or tools. More importantly, reviews encourage collective responsibility. Since the whole team contributes to the final quality, no single person feels isolated. Ultimately, consistent code reviews build trust and raise the standard of the entire team’s work.
